prompts.motion:
Adapt the exact mint green-haired fantasy woman in the reference into ONE production-ready chibi game sprite atlas. Preserve her very long pale mint green high ponytail, teal eyes, white flower and gold leaf hair ornament, dark teal ribbon, white off-shoulder puff sleeves, deep teal bodice with delicate gold trims, flowing white and teal layered skirt, long teal silk ribbons, white thigh-highs with gold vine details and white/teal shoes. Her magical instrument is the small GOLD CRESCENT MOON WIND CHIME from the reference, with translucent aqua hanging tubes and a feather. She has NO sword, NO mechanical armor, NO gun, NO animal ears. Cute polished anime cel shaded chibi of about 2.7 heads height, bold readable outline, consistent anatomy/scale/outfit in EVERY cell, readable at 90px tall. Same rendering quality as a finished fantasy mobile game sprite. Front three-quarter perspective facing RIGHT. The crescent instrument floats just ahead of her right hand; keep it inside each cell. Hair and skirt motions follow body with a delay. No ground, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no gridlines, true transparent background.
Exact layout: ONE WIDE 1536x1024 RGBA sprite atlas with EXACTLY SIX equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 24 complete figures, one per 256x256 cell. No overlapping cells or cropping of hair, shoes, ribbons or chime. Plant support foot baseline at y=240 in every upright cell, body centered x=128, head top near y=26, margins at least 10px. Keep every head and torso the SAME size; change limb articulation not drawing scale.
Row 1 indices 0-5: 0 blink eyes closed relaxed ready; 1 breathing in gently, open eyes; 2 exhaling, ribbons still trailing; 3 relaxed weight shift with hair settled; 4 cheerful victory with lifted chime; 5 gentle smile ready.
Row 2 indices 6-11: six clearly different consecutive frames of one light graceful walking cycle RIGHT while holding chime ready at chest. 6 right heel contact left toe trails; 7 right leg weight down left knee lifts; 8 left leg passes right support; 9 left heel contact right toe trails; 10 left leg weight down right knee lifts; 11 right leg passes left support. Alternate support feet, knee bend and shoe silhouettes clearly. Ponytail and ribbons lag torso changes; keep foot baseline consistent.
Row 3 indices 12-17: 12 neutral ready both feet grounded, crescent floats ahead of hand; 13 anticipatory gathering gesture, chime drawn close; 14 forward spell sweep begins, right arm reaches RIGHT; 15 release peak, forward lunge and crescent pushed RIGHT, ribbons stream behind; 16 follow-through returning balance, hair and sleeves still trailing; 17 recovered ready. Keep only the chime, NO baked magic trails or glow clouds; effects are separate. These gestures will represent close-range wind slash and short wind dash.
Row 4 indices 18-23: 18 hit flinch eyes squeezed and shoulders back; 19 low stagger knees bent chime retained; 20 regaining balance; 21 returned ready after hurt; 22 defeated kneeling head lowered and chime lowered; 23 defeated seated sideways with closed eyes, both legs and full ponytail visible, chime rests beside her. No injury or gore.

Preserve her exact original face, pose, mature anime proportions, very long pale mint green hair, white flower gold leaf ornament, white teal gold outfit, ribbons, white stockings, shoes and the floating golden crescent moon wind chime with feather and translucent aqua chimes, plus the original delicate floating leaves and musical notes. One isolated transparent full-length character portrait.
prompts.avatar: Create ONE square in-game portrait icon of the EXACT mint green-haired fantasy woman in the reference. Head and upper shoulders only, keeping original adult anime facial identity, teal eyes, mint bangs, long mint high ponytail visible behind her, white flower with gold leaves and teal ribbon hair ornament, white teal gold collar. Warm confident gentle smile, clean dark outline readable in a 40px HUD. Head and hair ornaments fill 85 percent of square, face centered, transparent background, no frame, text or border. Same color palette and recognizable identity as reference, NOT a new character.
prompts.weapon: Create ONE isolated square 2D game skill icon of the golden CRESCENT MOON WIND CHIME floating over the hand in the reference illustration. Only the magical instrument: elegant gold crescent facing RIGHT, delicate white teal feather on its upper outside, three translucent aqua vertical chimes hanging in its middle and a small gold teardrop pendant below. NO person, hand, sword, gun, text, circle frame or background. Faithful white teal gold palette, crisp anime cel shading with a clear dark contour, simplified enough to read at 45px. Centered object fills 80% of square with clean transparent margin. True alpha transparency.
prompts.wind: Rearrange and refine the six teal-white wind crescent spell phases in the reference into a precise SIX CELL SPRITE ATLAS. OUTPUT MUST BE 1536x1024: THREE equal columns by TWO equal rows, each square cell 512x512. Exactly ONE complete crescent effect per cell, with 60px completely transparent margin on ALL FOUR SIDES within each cell, absolutely no overlap or clipping at cell boundaries. Full transparent RGBA background, no painted backdrop, no text, no numbers, no grid lines. Keep the same original teal/white wind crescent style with subtle gold flecks, crisp anime-painted edges and clear transparent crescent interiors. Row1: cell0 small curved anticipation streak at cell center; cell1 medium gathering crescent at center; cell2 strongest release crescent at center. Row2: cell3 outward trailing thinner crescent; cell4 breaking thin wind curls; cell5 very small fading wind curls and gold flecks at center. Each effect faces RIGHT (crescent's thick outward curved edge on the RIGHT, open cavity on the LEFT), anchored on the center of its own square, with at most 390px effect diameter in 512px cell. No character, no weapon, no background or floor. Precisely aligned separate cells suitable for game animation.
